name: Smilodon, Dire

facets.bk: Dire Smilodon from the Tome of Horrors Complete

body:
With fangs like swords, this cat’s gleaming eyes and wicked claws promise death to anything it sees as prey.

Dire Smilodon
CR 7

XP 3,200
N Large animal
Init +3; Senses low-light vision; Perception +13

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 12, flat-footed 17 (+3 Dex, +8 natural, –1 size)
hp 112 (9d8+72)
Fort +14, Ref +9, Will +6

OFFENSE

Speed 50 ft.
Melee bite +15 (2d6+10/19–20 plus grab plus bleed), 2 claws +15 (1d6+10 plus grab)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks bleed (1d3), pounce, rake (2 claws +15, 1d6+10)

STATISTICS

Str 31, Dex 17, Con 27, Int 2, Wis 16, Cha 10
Base Atk +6; CMB +17 (+21 grapple); CMD 30 (34 vs. trip)
Feats Improved Critical (bite), Power Attack, Run, Skill Focus (Perception, Stealth)
Skills Acrobatics +12, Perception +13, Stealth +11 (+15 in heavy undergrowth or tall grass), Swim +14; Racial Modifiers +4 Acrobatics, +4 Stealth (+8 in heavy undergrowth or tall grass)

ECOLOGY

Environment warm forests and plains
Organization solitary, pair or den (6–10)
Treasure none
